text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One effective method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. Breaking a project into milestones helps the team track progress and stay motivated along the way. Deliverables should be clearly defined so everyone knows what needs to be completed and when. It is also important to ensure stakeholder alignment, meaning that everyone involved agrees on the project's objectives from the start. When goals are well planned and everyone shares the same understanding, projects are more likely to succeed and meet expectations.
